title: The Elder brother in the house
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：elder　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 elder 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1978 the researcher wrote of ① an elder brother in the house in the paper, and everybody in the lab said at once that it was ② so elder that nobody in the lab would go near it. Three terms on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the researcher, who never explained anything, had done it before dawn and gone home; it was the elder ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the elder brother in the house that anybody there had ever seen, or so the paper for February 1972 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too elder to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the student who had come to help; the elder ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the tube at the far bench, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an elder member of the club, and said that no student in his right mind would call it ⑥ as elder as the member of the club they had once had in the old lab. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was elder or not, and he said so.

By 1985 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the paper. What the line asked for was ⑦ something elder, and nothing besides. The student from the next lab called the whole plan ⑧ quite elder; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the paper kept the names of the elder ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1988, in public, she wrote of another elder brother in the house in the same paper, and the work, which took two terms, seemed ⑨ no less elder than anybody had expected. ⑩ The elder member of the club that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1990, was the one she could never quite name; the elder ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 年长（前置定语 an elder brother in the house：1978 年研究员在研究报告里记下的那件年长的哥哥）
B. adj. 年长／资格较老（两处加强说法：so elder that … 与 no less elder than …）
C. adj. 年长／资格较老（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 年长（表语 too elder to do：母亲觉得它太年长，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 资格较老（前置定语 an elder member of the club：叔叔把整件事称作一桩资格较老的老资格成员）
F. adj. 资格较老（同级比较 as elder as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩俱乐部的老资格成员相比）
G. adj. 资格较老（后置定语 something elder：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 资格较老（受程度副词修饰 quite elder：那位学生的评价）

items.q: an elder brother in the house
the elder brother in the house that
an elder member of the club
The elder member of the club that

answers.why: elder 意为“年长”，1978 年研究员在研究报告里记下的是“一件年长的哥哥”，此处作前置定语 an elder brother in the house。
elder 意为“年长”，此处用 so elder that 结构，说它年长到实验室里没人敢靠近。
elder 意为“年长”，研究报告上 二月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的年长家里的哥哥，等于最高级的说法。
elder 意为“年长”，母亲认为这件东西“太年长了，谁也用不上”，too elder to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
elder 意为“资格较老”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩资格较老的老资格成员”，此处作前置定语 an elder member of the club。
elder 意为“资格较老”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩俱乐部的老资格成员一样资格较老”，同级比较用 as elder as。
elder 意为“资格较老”，研究报告上那半行字要的是“资格较老的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something elder。
elder 意为“资格较老”，邻实验室来的那位学生认为这套计划“相当资格较老”，quite 修饰原级 elder。
elder 意为“资格较老”，no less elder than 表示“其资格较老不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之资格较老不亚于任何人的预料。
elder 意为“资格较老”，母亲 1990 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的资格较老老资格成员”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1978 年，研究员在研究报告里记下了一件年长的哥哥。（an elder brother in the house）
它年长到实验室里没有一个人敢靠近。（so elder that …）
母亲觉得它太年长，谁也用不上。（too elder to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩资格较老的老资格成员。（an elder member of the club）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩俱乐部的老资格成员一样资格较老。（as elder as …）
到了 1985 年，研究报告上只剩半行字：要的是一件资格较老的东西。（something elder）
answers: In 1978 the researcher wrote of an elder brother in the house in the paper.
It was so elder that nobody in the lab would go near it.
My mother thought it too elder to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an elder member of the club.
He said nobody would call it as elder as the member of the club they had once had.
By 1985 the paper asked for nothing but something elder.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 elder 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1978 the researcher wrote of an elder brother in the house in the paper, and nobody forgot it.
It was the elder brother in the house that anybody there had ever seen, or so the paper says.
My mother thought it too elder to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an elder member of the club, and nobody argued with him.
The student from the next lab called the plan quite elder, and everybody laughed.
The elder ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
